title: Multimeter Usage Simulator
description: Drag two probes onto a real circuit in three meter modes -- and find a short the meter can see but your eyes cannot.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

educational.audience: Mentors and students doing their first pre-power check

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a simple breadboard circuit, the learner demonstrates how to use a multimeter's continuity, voltage, and resistance modes to verify the circuit before and after powering it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Choose a mode, drag the red and black probes to any two holes, and read the meter
pedagogical.assessment: Turn on the hidden short and ask the learner to find it with the meter before the power goes on.
